tasks.title: NaN showing for files excluded from diff
tasks.description: files in .gitattributes are showing a diff of NNaN when marked for exclusion in a diff. i want any files excluded from the diff to not be shown in either the difflux or difflux ls commands.
i dont like the name of the ls command. please change the difflux ls command to difflux tree. it is more descriptive that way.
tasks.title: update ls to tree

tasks.description:
Root cause: Chokidar v5's ignored option with glob patterns doesn't work because anymatch's ** doesn't traverse dot-prefixed path segments.

Solution: Replace glob-based ignored patterns with a function-based approach. The function checks each path against both custom patterns (from .diffluxignore) and default patterns (node_modules, .git, dist, build, tmp, coverage, .cache, .next, .nuxt, .vite, __pycache__, .pyc, .log, .DS_Store).

Tested on ~/Code/task with 49,000+ files (including plugin/node_modules with 42,000+ files) - works correctly.
